conceptual_quality_basis: Lock-in requires a sharp, novel, coherent result with explanatory or unification value.
consequence_delta: Carrier transfer remains blocked until uniformity and advice discipline are certified.

main_problem_balance.allowed_claim: Claim only the local theorem, obstruction, worked example, transfer boundary, or demotion supported by the live ledger.
main_problem_balance.balance_test: Every consolidation must state what larger-problem gate it changes and which gate remains untouched.
forbidden_claims: Do not advertise a local subgoal as the full target theorem.
Do not replace a missing transfer theorem by narrative continuity.
main_problem_balance.larger_problem_boundary: The main target remains open until the target theorem, transfer, and non-claim boundaries are proved in the original problem setting.
main_problem_balance.local_subgoal_scope: Carrier transfer remains blocked until uniformity and advice discipline are certified.

non_claims: Do not claim the main problem is solved from a subgoal.
Do not promote a definition-built transfer theorem.
Do not advertise a local subgoal as the full target theorem.
Do not replace a missing transfer theorem by narrative continuity.

publication_consolidation_control.budget_exhaustion_action: write a handoff, demote or block the subgoal, and return to conceptual exploration before any new publication consolidation
publication_consolidation_control.recursion_guard: No nested publication-consolidation loop is allowed; side work must fit the current budget or return to exploration.
publication_consolidation_control.reentry_condition: only a new live learning event that changes a hard gate, supplies a missing object, or resolves a named blocker may start a fresh consolidation window

return_to_exploration_note: write a handoff, demote or block the subgoal, and return to conceptual exploration before any new publication consolidation
